name: avatar-group-hover
title: Avatar Group Hover
description: Avatar group for vertical reels: overlapping brand-gradient avatars lift from the centre and bounce back, like a hover on a team row. Size and overlap are fields. Brand palette, Montserrat initials, sized for the 780 px graphics field. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="avatar-group-hover": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Avatar diameter, with the initials scaling alongside it.

variables.label: Overlap
variables.description: How far each avatar tucks under the one before it, as a share of its own diameter.
